choices.label: Dancers smear in long-exposure trails while Poet stands dead still
Translucent cyan/gold Soul cel peels upward out of opaque Body
Soul rises past moons and laundry lines to white-hot equatorial plain
Three angels tip silver ice-bath basins over the overheated Soul
Cooled Soul descends and locks beside Body with 6px double-cel offset
Outside marquee, catches brief glimpse of EX's back in rain crowd

I2_threshold.rule: Soul completes cooling arc and holds permanent 2-cel parallax offset (q_end >= 0.86).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: After t=6.0s, ||pos(Soul) - pos(Body)|| >= 4.0px on 100% of frames.
